text: Male, adult. Muscular build. Tan skin. Black hair: short, thick, wavy, swept back. Square face with heavy brow ridges, deep-set eyes, wide nose, full lips. Wears dark brown leather armor: segmented chestplate, skirted cuirass, arm bracers, greaves, sandals. Carries sword at side. Standing front-facing, arms relaxed. Other panels show same figure from sides and back. Close-ups detail eye, lip, hair, skin tone, ear, and fabric texture.
